newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates fall near end of reserve period.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates fall near end of reserve period.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were lower at midday on Friday amid loosening liquidity nearing the end of the current monthly reserve period on November 3, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.058 percent against Wednesday's 5.267 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.00-5.10 against 5.15-5.20. The market was closed on Thursday for natinal holiday.
The banking system's accumulated reserve excess showed a positive T$34.9 billion, indicating loose liquidity.
Bond yields fell on early buying, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.7275-7300 against 5.7625. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
